question: The adaptive response to intracellular bacteria mediated by CD4 + T cells:

options.opa: It is called Th1 and is induced by IL-12 and interferon gamma (IFN-γ).
options.opb: It is called Th17 and is induced by IL 17 in IFN-γ.
options.opc: It is called Th 1 and is induced by IL-1 and IFN-γ.
options.opd: It is called Th 12 and is mediated by IL-12 and IFN-γ.
